<thought>Based on the observed isotopic peaks spaced by ~1.003 Da and the relative intensities (M+1 ≈ 11 % of M, M+2 ≈ 1 % of M), the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution and does not show the characteristic Cl, Br, or S patterns. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
